value.rationale: Sparse fixed composition is a natural way to resolve the structure of extremal circular palindromic words and separates the first genuine three-marker interactions. This parameterwise all-length exact invariant and rigid equality classification go beyond a numerical lower-bound construction or a short unrestricted table; the extremizers also give structured candidates for the larger unrestricted problem.
